prompt: Create a production game particle sprite atlas derived from the approved reference mockup's angular red fragments and tiny streaks. Bottom middle and bottom right: two thin vertical short spark streaks, one straight and one slightly jagged, bright compact head at TOP and rapidly fading segmented trail BELOW for upward movement. Each sprite occupies the central 60% of its cell with generous transparent margins and no overlap. All sprites neutral white/light gray, tint applied later by engine. Flat emissive texture, no 3D lighting, no shadows, no room, no teleporter, no text, no labels, no borders, no checkerboard painted into image. Actual transparent background with alpha.
